2000.o: Swamishri performed the Murti pratishtha of Akshar Purushotttam Maharaj at the Swaminarayan Mandir, Navakhal
w: On this auspicious function, 30 people pledged to abstrain from liqur and 40 from smoking.
After lunch, Swamishri travelled to Bamangam. In the evening assembly, Lord Harikrishna was honored.

During his routine walk in the morning a call got connected to Bhuj (till then all phone communications to Bhuj were dead). Swamishri cancelled his walk and attended the phone. Despite several disconnections, Swamishri had called 12 more times and imparted detailed guidance and instructions for the relief work.
At 10.40am, Vasant Panchami assembly was held. After bhajans, discourses, announcement of relief operations, Swamishri finally blessed the assembly. ( Click for more details )

After his morning puja, Swamishri performed the pratishtha rituals of pujan and arti of the murtis of Shri Akshar Purushottam Maharaj and other deities for the BAPS hari mandirs of Dora and Ankhi villages in Bharuch district.
Swamishri performed the murti-pratishtha rituals of pujan and arti of Akshar-Purushottam Maharaj, Radha-Krishna Dev, Guru Parampara, Hanumanji and Ganapatiji for the BAPS hari mandir in Vakaner.

Out in the courtyard, an elderly, devoted old devotee named Prahladbhai Rao was sitting on a chair. A satsangi from the time of Shastriji Maharaj, who had offered everything he had for the Sanstha, he is one of the old devotees of the Vadodara satsang mandal.
Pramukh Swami Maharaj met him up close and said, "You have done much bhajan of Shastriji Maharaj and Yogiji Maharaj, so you are happy."
Prahladji said, "Bapa! I am ready, take me to Akshardham."
Swamishri said, "When you are fully ready, Shastriji Maharaj and Yogiji Maharaj will come and take you."
He said with elation, "I am ready."
Swamishri said, "Then that is it, they will take you."
And just a few days later, smiling, this devoted satsangi left for Akshardham.

st.t: Hon. Premier Kathleen Wynne of Ontario, Canada, Visits Swaminarayan Akshardham
w: Hon. Premier Kathleen Wynne of Ontario traditionally welcomed at Swaminarayan Akshardham in New Delhi Hon. Premier Kathleen Wynne of Ontario gifted a visit memento at Swaminarayan Akshardham in New Delhi
Hon. Premier Kathleen Wynne of Ontario, Canada, visited Swaminarayan Akshardham in New Delhi to experience India’s ageless beauty, borderless culture and timeless values.

Premier Wynne was welcomed in a traditional Indian manner with a garland of flowers, a chandlo (vermillion powder) and the tying of the sacred kalva (sacred thread) by trustees and senior volunteers on behalf of Swaminarayan Akshardham and BAPS Swaminarayan Sanstha.

Premier Wynne’s Ontario thirty member delegation included Minister Michael Chan (MPP), Minister Brad Duguid (MPP), Associate Minister Dipika Damerla (MPP), Minister Vic Dhillon (MPP), Minister Harinder Takhar (MPP), Minister Amrit Mangat (MPP), Deputy High Commissioner Jess Dutton from the Canadian High Commission in New Delhi and Jane Rounthwaite serving as the President and Managing Partner at the Osborne Group.
After admiring the Mayur Dwar (Peacock Gate), the delegation made their way to the Swaminarayan Akshardham Mandir where they witnessed the world’s ‘Largest Comprehensive Hindu Temple’.

After offering respects and viewing the mandir’s architecture, the delegation visited the Gajendra Pithika (Elephant Plinth) that includes 148 life-sized carved stone elephants depicting message of social harmony, peace and spirituality.

Premier Wynne and the Ontario delegation offered prayers for world peace and harmony by offering ‘abhishek’, the ceremonial pouring of sanctified water from 151 holy rivers, lakes and ponds across India on the sacred image of Shri Neelkanth Varni.
Sharing her experience at Akshardham, Premier Wynne wrote, “Thank you so much for the wonderful visit. The temple is a miracle of human skill, faith and imagination. A true inspiration.”
Today in the Sunday assembly, showering nectar drops of blessings, Mahant Swami Maharaj said:

"Maharaj, Swami and this Satpurush, this is a straight line understanding. Since we have met this great one, how much respect must we keep for him? How much must we do? If we think about Shriji Maharaj, 'What a God we have met!', then nothing will be lacking in any way, lust, anger and everything will go, ekantik dharma will be attained, and nothing will remain to be done. But to please him we must do everything. His pleasure is gained in many ways:
"1. Conviction: there should be no hollowness in it. Such firm refuge that nothing but God comes to mind.

"2. Dharma of celibacy: other people observe it too, so for us, who have met God, it can certainly be done. It is in this that we stand apart. Suppose Pramukh Swami Maharaj were to come to your home? And stay for a week or a month? How much joy there would be! So Shriji Maharaj says in Vachanamrut Gadhada II 33, 'If one observes the dharma of celibacy, God remains constantly with us.' So keep making it firm. Do not say, 'It cannot be observed.' Say, 'It will be observed, it will be observed.' In the whole universe there is no talk of this dharma of celibacy. For the householder, 'One wife, ever a brahmachari (celibate)', and for the renunciant, 'No woman has even been born.' Do not tire. Keep at it. God is with you. Then even if you do not want to keep God, he will stay.

"3. Do not fall into negative feelings and seeing faults. One may have done deeds worthy of going to heaven, but if he falls into negative feelings and seeing faults, he goes to hell. On the other hand, one may understand nothing, but if he imbibes virtues, his sins are burnt and heaps of merit are gained. Negative feelings and seeing faults are like snakes and ladders. They bring you down from 98 to 6. It depends on the fault. Even a small one will bring you down 5 or 6 squares. Maharaj told Lala Pala, 'At the time of your death I will come in person to take you, and take you by the wrist.' Still he became a ghost, because he had wronged Gopalanand Swami. So do not act in such a way. If you have wronged someone, pray with a choked voice. Clear that account. Not after a month or two, settle it
"at once.

"If we keep conviction and our religious disciplines and do not fall into negative feelings and seeing faults, if these three things are there, then we go straight to Akshardham. No one will stop us on the way."
